The following events took place in '''49 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Menahuun]] capture [[Byrch Dyshkava]], following his own claim. {{Circa}}<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>
*[[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]] leaves [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], taking up the work of a mercenary pilot [[46 BBY/Legends|three years later]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap Note">''[[The Starfighter Trap]]'', Till claims she was 35 years old, had left Naboo on her nineteenth birthday and been a mercenary pilot for 13 years, which, given that the story takes place in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], allows to arrive at the date of 49 BBY.</ref>
*[[Artagan Truax]] rescues weapon designer/arms dealer [[Iram Radique]] from failed [[Bando Gora]] assassination attempt.<ref>[[Maul: Lockdown]]</ref>
